clock_status: filename epoch is a metadata selection key only; actual event/recorded clocks and feed availability must pass the downstream audit
selection_rule: Metadata-only: at the pinned revision, pair book/trade Parquet filenames whose UTC epoch stamps differ by <=2 seconds; retain pairs with book size >=10,000,000 bytes and trade size >=100,000 bytes; choose 30 eligible dates evenly over the sorted eligible-date list, then choose the 20th and 80th percentile eligible time-pairs within each date. No payload, price, label, score, or liquidation field was used to select dates or files.
